text: Hello, I'm Georgie.
And I'm Phil.
Welcome to another episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 欢迎来到《真简易英语》的另一集。
zh_hant: 歡迎來到《真簡易英語》的另一集。

text: Remember, you can watch this podcast with subtitles to help you
zh: 记住，你可以带着字幕看这个播客，帮助理解。
zh_hant: 記住，你可以帶著字幕看這個播客，幫助理解。

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Phil.
How are you doing?
I'm good.
A little bit tired, but yeah, I'm good.
Oh no, why?
Lots of housework this weekend.
zh: 这个周末干了很多家务活。
zh_hant: 這個週末幹了很多家務活。

text: We had to get the house ready.
So, yeah, lots to do.
You said ready.
Ready for what?
Oh, we've got some people coming to visit, so we had to get ready for that.
zh: 哦，有人要来拜访，所以我们得做好准备。
zh_hant: 哦，有人要來拜訪，所以我們得做好準備。

text: Well, Phil, we are talking about housework today in real easy English.
zh: 好吧，菲尔，今天我们在《真简易英语》里谈家务活。
zh_hant: 好吧，菲爾，今天我們在《真簡易英語》裡談家務活。

text: So housework is all of those jobs you do in the house,
zh: 家务活就是在家里做的那些活儿，
zh_hant: 家務活就是在家裡做的那些活兒，

text: so cleaning, washing, cooking, things like that.
zh: 像打扫、洗衣服、做饭之类的。
zh_hant: 像打掃、洗衣服、做飯之類的。

text: So Phil, you said at the weekend you did a lot of housework.
zh: 所以菲尔，你说周末做了很多家务。
zh_hant: 所以菲爾，你說週末做了很多家務。

text: What did you do?
Well, I mean, we share out the housework,
but I had to make sure I was cleaning the kitchen.
I also did, we say do the hoovering or do the vacuuming
around all the carpets,
to make sure that's nice and clean under all the furniture.
zh: 确保家具下面干净整洁。
zh_hant: 確保傢俱下面乾淨整潔。

text: So, Georgie, do you do a lot of housework?
zh: 那乔治，你做很多家务吗？
zh_hant: 那喬治，你做很多家務嗎？

text: Well, I live in a shared flat,
so I have two housemates who are not super
zh: 我有两个室友，他们不太
zh_hant: 我有兩個室友，他們不太

text: clean,
so I have a bit of a routine with them.
zh: 所以我和他们有个固定的安排。
zh_hant: 所以我和他們有個固定的安排。

text: Every weekend,
one person will clean the communal areas.
zh: 有一个人会打扫公共区域。
zh_hant: 有一個人會打掃公共區域。

text: So those are the areas that are shared.
So the kitchen and the living room, one person will clean those properly.
zh: 比如厨房和客厅，一个人会认真打扫这些地方。
zh_hant: 比如廚房和客廳，一個人會認真打掃這些地方。

text: So wipe the surfaces, wipe away the crumbs.
So the crumbs are little bits of food,
then hoover or sweep the floor.
So that removes the crumbs from the floor so that the floor is ready to be mopped.
zh: 这样能把碎屑从地上去掉，方便拖地。
zh_hant: 這樣能把碎屑從地上去掉，方便拖地。

text: So when you mop, that's when you make the floor wet and properly clean.
zh: 拖地就是让地面变湿并彻底干净。
zh_hant: 拖地就是讓地面變溼並徹底乾淨。

text: That's a really impressive system.
The way you've got it so organized,
we always find we run out of time to get a lot of housework done,
zh: 我们总是发现没时间做很多家务，
zh_hant: 我們總是發現沒時間做很多家務，

text: or we're doing stuff at the weekend, or we're working during the week, and so some of those jobs,
zh: 要么周末忙其他事，要么工作日上班，所以有些活儿，
zh_hant: 要麼週末忙其他事，要麼工作日上班，所以有些活兒，

text: they get put off and put off and put off, which isn't good,
zh: 就一直拖着拖着拖着，这不好，
zh_hant: 就一直拖著拖著拖著，這不好，

text: but it happens sometimes.
Well, there's also just so many other things we would rather be doing,
zh: 嗯，而且还有很多我们更愿意做的事，
zh_hant: 嗯，而且還有很多我們更願意做的事，

text: so yeah, it's easy to put off, to delay.
Georgie, we're talking about household chores.
There is one that you really hate doing.
zh: 有一件事你特别讨厌做。
zh_hant: 有一件事你特別討厭做。

text: Yes, Phil, there is one job that comes to mind immediately,
zh: 是的菲尔，有一件事我马上想到，
zh_hant: 是的菲爾，有一件事我馬上想到，

text: which is cleaning the bathroom, specifically cleaning the toilet.
zh: 就是打扫浴室，特别是刷马桶。
zh_hant: 就是打掃浴室，特別是刷馬桶。

text: Oh yes, not very nice.
Yeah, no, not at all.
Do you have one that you hate the most?
I think what I really dislike is trying to clean
zh: 我觉得最讨厌的是清理
zh_hant: 我覺得最討厭的是清理

text: the bits on the cooker where everything gets stuck on,
zh: 炉子上东西粘住的地方，
zh_hant: 爐子上東西粘住的地方，

text: and you have to really rub it and scrub it really hard.
I hate those jobs, so do you.
zh: 我讨厌这些活儿，你也是。
zh_hant: 我討厭這些活兒，你也是。

text: that you share the chores.
Do you get your kids to do chores?
zh: 你让你的孩子做家务吗？
zh_hant: 你讓你的孩子做家務嗎？

text: Now that's a really good question.
We ask the kids to do chores,
and sometimes they do something
okay, but not a lot.
I'd really like them to be able to keep their rooms tidy.
zh: 我真希望他们能保持房间整洁。
zh_hant: 我真希望他們能保持房間整潔。

text: That's never going to happen, it feels.
I'd really like it if they could help out cleaning the living room, putting things away.
zh: 我真希望他们能帮忙打扫客厅，把东西放好。
zh_hant: 我真希望他們能幫忙打掃客廳，把東西放好。

text: But yeah, we haven't taught them very well.
Maybe one day.
Maybe.
It's when you become an adult, I think, that you really appreciate a clean space.
zh: 我觉得是成年后，你才真正珍惜干净的空间。
zh_hant: 我覺得是成年後，你才真正珍惜乾淨的空間。

text: So hopefully that will come.
I was terrible as a teenager.
I didn't do much as a teenager at all,
so this is just coming back to me now.
zh: 所以现在才慢慢开始做这些。
zh_hant: 所以現在才慢慢開始做這些。

text: Yeah, well, me too.
So we've talked about chores that we hate doing,
zh: 我们聊了讨厌做的家务，
zh_hant: 我們聊了討厭做的家務，

text: but are there any jobs that you enjoy doing?
Well, you know what, laundry or washing,
zh: 你知道吗，洗衣服或洗衣，
zh_hant: 你知道嗎，洗衣服或洗衣，

text: that's washing your clothes, that can sometimes be really satisfying.
zh: 就是洗你的衣服，有时候真的很让人满足。
zh_hant: 就是洗你的衣服，有時候真的很讓人滿足。

text: When you get a lot of it done,
zh: 当你洗了一大批的时候，
zh_hant: 當你洗了一大批的時候，

text: and actually I've just got a new washing machine,
zh: 而且我刚买了新洗衣机，
zh_hant: 而且我剛買了新洗衣機，

text: and it's much bigger than the one I had before, so I can do so much in one load.
zh: 而且它比我以前的那个大得多，所以我一次能洗很多。
zh_hant: 而且它比我以前的那個大得多，所以我一次能洗很多。

text: Phil, that is so exciting.
Even better, because it's summer at the moment,
zh: 更好的是，因为现在是夏天，
zh_hant: 更好的是，因為現在是夏天，

text: I can get it dry so quick, it's amazing.
I love putting a load of washing in the washing machine and then having it dry by the end of the day,
zh: 我喜欢把一大堆衣服放进洗衣机，然后到一天结束时就晾干了。
zh_hant: 我喜歡把一大堆衣服放進洗衣機，然後到一天結束時就晾乾了。

text: that is so good.
It's the best thing.
Teenage Georgie would be so disappointed that I'm excited by laundry, but here we go.
zh: 十几岁的乔治看到我为洗衣兴奋会失望，但就这样吧。
zh_hant: 十幾歲的喬治看到我為洗衣興奮會失望，但就這樣吧。

text: OK, Phil, let's recap the vocabulary we used in this conversation,
zh: 好，菲尔，我们回顾一下这段对话用的词汇，
zh_hant: 好，菲爾，我們回顧一下這段對話用的詞彙，

text: starting with housework.
So, this is the general term for jobs that we have to do in the house.
zh: 这是指家里必须做的活的一般说法。
zh_hant: 這是指家裡必須做的活的一般說法。

text: And then we had chores, which are the specific jobs that you have to do.
zh: 然后还有chores，就是具体要做的活儿。
zh_hant: 然後還有chores，就是具體要做的活兒。

text: For example, laundry.
Yes.
So, laundry is washing your clothes.
We say do the laundry or just do the washing.
Yes, and we had some other chores, for example,
hoovering and sweeping the floor,
which is what you do when there are crumbs on the floor.
zh: 当地上有碎屑时就这么做。
zh_hant: 當地上有碎屑時就這麼做。

text: After you've swept the crumbs, you can mop the floor,
which is when you make the floor wet and clean it like that.
zh: 就是让地面湿了再擦干净。
zh_hant: 就是讓地面溼了再擦乾淨。

text: Yes, we also talked about jobs that you hate.
zh: 对，我们还谈了讨厌的活儿。
zh_hant: 對，我們還談了討厭的活兒。

text: And sometimes when you really hate a job,
zh: 有时候你特别讨厌一件事时，
zh_hant: 有時候你特別討厭一件事時，

text: you end up putting it off.
Off, that means to delay it.
If you put something off, you delay something sometimes because you just don't want to do it.
zh: 如果你put something off，就是推迟，有时因为不想做。
zh_hant: 如果你put something off，就是推遲，有時因為不想做。

text: So, Phil, that is the end of this episode of Real Easy English,
zh: 所以菲尔，这是《真简易英语》这集的结尾，
zh_hant: 所以菲爾，這是《真簡易英語》這集的結尾，

text: but we'll be back next week, won't we?
zh: 但我们下周还会回来，对吧？
zh_hant: 但我們下週還會回來，對吧？

text: Yes, we'll be back with another episode.
Also, don't forget about that worksheet that's on our website bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 另外，别忘了我们网站bbclearningenglish.com上的那个练习单。
zh_hant: 另外，別忘了我們網站bbclearningenglish.com上的那個練習單。

text: Goodbye for now.
Bye.
Want more easy programmes?
There's more to explore on our website.
zh: 我们网站上还有更多内容。
zh_hant: 我們網站上還有更多內容。

text: Try Easy English Conversations to practice
zh: 试试《轻松英语对话》来练习
zh_hant: 試試《輕鬆英語對話》來練習

text: introducing yourself and other beginner topics.
zh: 自我介绍和其他初级话题。
zh_hant: 自我介紹和其他初級話題。

text: Or learn through our exciting challenge series like the London Letter Challenge.
zh: 或者通过我们有趣的挑战系列，比如《伦敦信函挑战》学习。
zh_hant: 或者透過我們有趣的挑戰系列，比如《倫敦信函挑戰》學習。

text: And of course, we have video episodes of Real Easy English so you can watch our presenters with subtitles to help you.
zh: 当然，我们还有《简易英语》的视频节目，你可以观看主持人的讲解并配有字幕辅助。
zh_hant: 當然，我們還有《簡易英語》的影片節目，你可以觀看主持人的講解並配有字幕輔助。

text: Find all our easy podcasts and videos on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 在bbclearningenglish.com上找到我们所有简易播客和视频。
zh_hant: 在bbclearningenglish.com上找到我們所有簡易播客和影片。
